label: Она
description: Third-person feminine singular sentences focused on verb agreement and feminine predicate forms.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person feminine singular motion. 1. 'Она' marks the subject as feminine singular. 2. 'Идет' matches third person singular. 3. 'Домой' keeps the direction of motion clear.

Strategic focus: Verb agreement with feminine subject. 1. 'Читает' is the proper third-person singular form. 2. 'Книгу' stays as the direct object. 3. This sentence trains the learner to listen for the verb change after the subject changes.

Strategic focus: Simple active sentence. 1. 'Пишет' is third-person singular and does not change for gender in the present tense. 2. 'Письмо' is a straightforward direct object. 3. This sentence gives a stable base for pattern recognition.

Strategic focus: Perception verb in third person. 1. 'Видит' is the correct feminine singular subject form. 2. 'Стол' keeps the object practical. 3. This sentence is useful for building automatic agreement recognition.

Strategic focus: Emotion plus demonstrative noun. 1. 'Любит' is third-person singular. 2. 'Этот дом' remains masculine and stable. 3. This sentence shows that the subject gender changes the verb choice only where the form allows it.

Strategic focus: Irregular present tense. 1. 'Ест' is the third-person form of 'есть'. 2. 'Хлеб' is a simple object. 3. This sentence is practical and helps learners memorize a high-frequency irregular form.
Strategic focus: Survival action. 1. 'Пьет' keeps the sentence in third person singular. 2. 'Воду' is the feminine object in accusative. 3. This is an extremely useful everyday sentence.
Strategic focus: Negation. 1. 'Не' directly negates the verb. 2. 'Понимает' is the proper third-person form. 3. This line is good for real-life situations where understanding is the main issue.

Strategic focus: Desire plus noun. 1. 'Хочет' is the correct third-person singular present tense. 2. 'Кофе' is an everyday item and easy to remember. 3. This sentence sounds natural and conversational.

Strategic focus: Activity and place. 1. 'Работает' is the third-person singular form. 2. 'Дома' functions as a natural location word. 3. This sentence is useful because it demonstrates the contrast between subject agreement and stable adverbial location.

Strategic focus: Language use. 1. 'Говорит' is the correct feminine singular subject form. 2. 'По-русски' is the natural adverbial language marker. 3. This sentence is a high-value identity line for learners.
Strategic focus: Knowledge. 1. 'Знает' is third-person singular. 2. 'Это' is the referenced object or idea. 3. This line shows the sentence core very clearly and cleanly.
Strategic focus: Taking an object. 1. 'Берет' is the third-person singular form. 2. 'Книгу' is the direct object and stays easy to picture. 3. This sentence reinforces the object-verb relationship.

Strategic focus: Physical action. 1. 'Открывает' is the feminine singular present form. 2. 'Дверь' keeps the action grounded. 3. This sentence is strong for repetition because it is vivid and practical.

Strategic focus: Perception. 1. 'Слышит' is third-person singular. 2. 'Музыку' is the heard object in accusative. 3. This sentence helps learners treat perception verbs just like other transitive verbs.

Strategic focus: Object pronoun form. 1. 'Видит' is the third-person singular present tense. 2. 'Меня' is the object form of 'я'. 3. This is a good sentence for understanding how pronouns shift when they are not the subject.

Strategic focus: Everyday routine. 1. 'Делает' is a flexible and high-frequency verb. 2. 'Чай' is a practical, memorable noun. 3. This sentence is useful because it is simple without being artificial.
Strategic focus: Carrying action. 1. 'Несет' is the correct feminine singular verb form. 2. 'Сумку' is the carried object. 3. This sentence makes the verb-object relation very easy to see.
Strategic focus: Finding something. 1. 'Находит' is third-person singular. 2. 'Ключ' is a very familiar noun. 3. This sentence is useful for reinforcing the same pattern across pronouns.

Strategic focus: Verb governance and prepositional case. 1. 'Думает' is third-person singular. 2. 'О работе' shows the prepositional form after 'о'. 3. This sentence is strong for teaching how verbs control the form of adjacent nouns.
